urlText: L2 and L3 partial line closures and extra early morning L1, L2, L3 services during Sydney Marathon
content:
Due to major road closures in the city and South East on Sunday 31 August for the Sydney Marathon, L2 and L3 light rail services will be impacted throughout the day. 
 
Additional early morning services will run from 3.45am on L1, L2 and L3 lines. 
 
Services changes, Sunday 31 August: 
  • L2 Randwick Line:  
    • From 3.45am to 11am L2 services will not run between Circular Quay and Town Hall. Services will run between Randwick and Town Hall only. 
    • From 11am, full L2 services between Circular Quay and Randwick will resume as normal. 
  • L3 Kingsford Line:  
    • From 3.45am to 6am L3 services will not run between Circular Quay and Town Hall. Services will run between Juniors Kingsford and Town Hall only.  
    • From 6am to 11am L3 services will not run between Circular Quay and Town Hall or between Moore Park and Juniors Kingsford. L3 services will run between Moore Park and Town Hall only.  
    • From 11am to 1.30pm L3 services will run between Moore Park and Circular Quay only. Services will not run between Moore Park and Juniors Kingsford.
    • From 1.30pm services resume as normal operating between Circular Quay and Juniors Kingsford in both directions. 
Due to major event road closures in the Kensington and Kingsford areas, light rail replacement buses will not be operating. 
 
When L2 and L3 services are partially closed between Circular Quay and Town Hall, use alternative transport including trains or walking if able to. 
 
When L3 services are partially closed between Moore Park and Juniors Kingsford, use alternative transport. L2 Randwick Line services continue to run to the city.  
 
Allow plenty of extra travel time as services will be busy. Visit the Sydney Marathon event page for more transport information.
subtitle: L2 and L3 partial line closures and extra early morning L1, L2, L3 services during Sydney Marathon
